question: What is the meaning of material safety certification in relation to certifications, standards, classifications and compliance, legal and regulatory information?
data_group: certifications, standards, classifications and compliance, legal and regulatory information
description: Material safety certification refers to the process of verifying that a product or material meets specific health and safety standards. This certification is often part of a broader system of product assessments, certifications, and standards, which may include classifications and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. Material safety certifications are typically based on data from Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS), and other relevant standards and regulations. These certifications help ensure that products are safe for use and comply with health and safety regulations. <|ENDINPUT>|
